title: Book Three · Chapter 118: The Lines Below the Fee
story:
Two weeks after Ronan posts his eighteenth letter, Leo's reply arrives.

Leo describes one practical class at his school. The students drew a shelf and worked out the wood sizes. His first shelf was too wide for the space on the sheet.

Ronan smiles. He can tell Kai about that.

The next afternoon, Anna brings her course information to the library. Her own reply came a few days earlier.

There is a printed sheet and a short letter. She puts both on the table between them.

“This is their longer course,” she says. “Two years.”

Ronan looks at the picture of a workroom. Students are standing beside large drawings.

Anna points to the lines below it.

“They teach maths and building plans. There is model work too.”

“You would like that.”

“I think so.”

She turns the sheet. The price is on the back.

The present class fee is two hundred and forty yuan for one term. A place in a shared room costs ninety more for that term.

Ronan finds a pencil.

“Three hundred and thirty.”

Anna nods, but her finger stays on the next line.

“Food is separate. Paper and other materials too.”

He reads it himself. The two prices do not cover the whole stay.

“And twelve for the bus,” he says.

“At the present price. Yes.”

He writes the journey below the other lines. Then he leaves spaces for food and materials.

“We don't know those yet.”

“No. My mum asked me to find out.”

Anna takes the pencil and adds the question. Then she points to the next part.

The letter asks for several drawings. It says a teacher will look at the work. It does not offer her a place.

“I need better drawings,” she says.

Ronan looks at the workroom picture again. Two years is much longer than a summer visit.

“Will you send yours now?”

“Not yet. I have school work first. I want to ask our teacher about the plans.”

She folds the price sheet back into the letter. Ronan moves his pencil away so the paper can lie flat.

Outside, Lin comes up the library steps. Anna sees her and lifts a hand.

“She wants to read this too,” Anna says.

Ronan moves his bag from the third chair. Lin sits down and opens her notebook. Anna takes out the workroom picture again.

Lin looks from the picture to Anna's notes.

“Can I see the room question?”

Anna passes the letter to her. Lin reads it, then moves the picture back into the light.

“The tables look large here.”

“Look at the people beside them,” Anna says.

At first, Ronan looked only at the long windows. Now he follows her finger to a student with a drawing across both arms.

“You could lose our whole classroom desk under that.”

“Your lunch too,” Lin says.

Anna laughs and spreads her hands to show the size of her present drawing. The three look again at the long tables near its windows.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

fee＝费用；term＝学期；shared room＝合住房间；separate＝另外计算的、分开的。

## 理解问题

1. 目前一学期课程费和住宿费合计多少？食物、材料与交通都包括了吗？
2. 这封课程信息是否等于录取通知？Anna现在准备先做什么？

## 读句子

**The two prices do not cover the whole stay.**

拆开看：The two prices / do not cover / the whole stay.

这两项价格／并没有包含／在那边生活学习的全部开支。
